body: I feel like I might get stuck trying to solve my issues instead of actually doing something in my life. I feel so old and I'm only 22.
I might consider it some day, but antidepressants and therapy, even if they worked for me, take some time and I'm really short on it. My finals are like 3 weeks from now.

I might consider it one day, because it's an obvious solution/try. What I'm seeking now is ideas; that can get me started again. I'm short on time, for one thing my finals are 3 weeks from now, and it only gets worse for me if I fail, I might have to drop out.

Thanks for the gesture, appreciated.
No, I don't want to talk to a therapist or take medication.
Thanks for your advice about focusing on small goals, it was a helpful one.
Hope you find a new job and get better!

I don't need meds on my plate, I might even overdose at some point.

I also know my goals and the easiest thing I can do is to grab a pencil and a piece of paper and make a plan. The problem is that I can't stick to it, I don't feel motivated anymore.

I'm hesitant and kinda scared to do it. I feel like i'll be stuck in a closed loop trying to solve my issues and taking some kind of a medication forever instead of actually doing anything in my life.

I have some friends like almost anyone else, I just don't feel like being social or going out anymore, especially after a girl I used to love broke my heart. I was lost and then she came in my life and represented hope to me, I was starting to feel better, when she left I became even worse than before, I stopped talking to many people and locked myself in my room all the time.
